tips.text: Ctrl+O shows everything Claude is doing, step by step. Press it again to go back.
Esc stops Claude at any moment. Nothing breaks: tell it what to do instead.
Scrolled up? Click Jump to bottom to see the latest answer (or press Ctrl+End on Windows).
Click the bar at the top to jump back to your last message.
/focus switches between a quiet view and seeing every step.
Esc twice, with nothing typed, goes back to an earlier point and undoes the changes since then.
Lost? Type /wait-what and Claude explains its last message again, in plain words.
To show Claude an error, take a screenshot and paste it in the box (Ctrl+V on a Mac, Alt+V on Windows).
